name: Relatable body question + in-app answer ("at what age did you find out…" reaction, mascot explains)
length: 12-17s, 1080x1920, creator selfie + answer card; works muted

shots.visual: Front camera, chest-up, bathroom/bedroom, natural light. Eyes widen, hand to mouth. No product visible.
shots.audio_text: Caption (top third, 64px white, black stroke): "at what age did you find out 'gold tone' means there's no gold in it??"

shots.visual: Hold the reaction; slow head shake, mouths "what". Do NOT talk.
shots.audio_text: Trending sound at -20 dB, or silence + one word "what??"

shots.visual: Hard cut to 9:16 answer card: brand character/avatar top-left, 2 chat bubbles typing in (CapCut "typewriter" 0.6s each)
shots.audio_text: Bubble 1 (≤22 words): "Gold tone = colour only. Most of it is brass with a thin plate that wears off with water and sweat."

shots.visual: Hands-only macro: LC necklace under a running tap, then on a towel, still bright
shots.audio_text: Bubble 2: "14K PVD bonds the gold to steel. Shower, swim, sleep in it."

shots.visual: End card: product grid on warm beige

prompts.prompt: Give me 60 true, surprising facts about gold jewelry, plating, sweat, water and skin that women 25-45 often learn late. Phrase each as "at what age did you find out ...?". Then mark which ones are supported by these product facts: {{PDP_FACTS}}. Drop anything medical.
1080x1920, background #F6EFE6, avatar circle 160px top-left, chat bubbles 900px wide, 44px Hanken Grotesk, max 2 bubbles, 22 words each. Duplicate the page per fact.
Film 10 reactions in one session: front camera, 4K 30fps, window light, neutral top, no jewelry visible. React to reading the fact for the first time; 3-5 s each; no speaking.
Translate the hook as a native Mexican-Spanish speaker would say it on TikTok, keep "¿a qué edad te enteraste...?" structure; ≤14 words.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: The reaction must happen before any product appears; product in the first second kills it.
Avoid: One fact per video. Two facts = no one remembers either.
Avoid: Facts must be true and checkable; a wrong fact in the comments sinks the account.
Avoid: Keep the answer card short enough to read twice in 5 seconds.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
